label: Social construction varies truth across supplied profiles
term: Social construction varies truth across supplied profiles
definition: For any actually true constructed content in the supplied scope, there exists a supplied attitude profile at which the same content fails to hold.
note: Analyst bridge, attribution deferred. This profile variation is neither an account of causation nor a claim that social origins always affect truth. Real application requires defending the profile variation while keeping content and non-attitude facts fixed. An institutional fact can vary with practices while the same proposition about a noninstitutional event can remain true across practices.
